queries: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS media_average FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(media_average) AS overall_average FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.Name AS media_type_name, ma.media_average, ma.media_average - o.overall_average AS above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ma.media_average > o.overall_average;

assumptions.assumption: Passing the file-size cutoff means exceeding 10,323,804 bytes. Tracks with zero milliseconds have no defined bytes-per-millisecond value and are ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is a maximum permitted file size, include tracks of 10,323,804 bytes or less.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is a minimum, and a track at the boundary also passes.

assumptions.assumption: Passing the file-size cutoff means being at or below 10,323,804 bytes. Tracks with zero milliseconds cannot yield a bytes-per-millisecond value and are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is a minimum size, include tracks at or above 10,323,804 bytes.
